digital shipping is a reality in the shipping business, but it is far from being a dominant and pervasive mode of operation.
the shipping industry is not ready for a full digital transformation.
the Greek owned shipping industry is not yet fully prepared for a digital mode of operation, but it is in a good position to take advantage of the emerging digital opportunities and challenges.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

digital shipping is a dynamic and complex field of research, with a variety of business models, modes of operation and technical options, as well as a variety of determinants and incentives, which should be taken into consideration by shipping companies and other industry stakeholders, when designing and implementing e business strategies and related policies.
, in the shipping industry, the adoption of digital shipping business practices and models is not only a technical matter, but also a strategic decision.

digital shipping business models are not a homogeneous set of practices and technologies, but they are rather an evolving and heterogeneous set of practices, technologies and business models, which are interlinked with organizational characteristics, strategies, market policies and business practices, as well as the broader business environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the shipping industry, digital business models and practices are evolving towards the development of a networked, collaborative and integrated maritime ecosystem, in which the digital mode of business operation is a key enabler of a more efficient and sustainable shipping industry.
the Greek owned shipping industry is not yet ready for a digital shipping mode of operation.
